title: 第四千二百二十三章 风雨欲来一第四千二百二十二章 主人
content_zh:
“八雷前辈，需要什么尽管拿，不必客气！”剑尘满不在乎的说道，显得十分豪迈，完全不把这些价值不可估量的上品神材当回事。
“这些神级上品的天材地宝，还有神级上品神丹，真是我想要什么就拿什么？”八雷尊者试探性的问道，带着明显的质疑与不相信。
因为他太清楚这些天材地宝的价值了，特别是在经历了端靖天界的战争后，更是让他无比深刻的体会到每一株上等神丹以及上品神丹所代表的意义。
这些资源，可都是救命之物啊，意义十分重大。
与文都上人和梦秋圣姑二人之间的战斗，他八雷尊者能支撑到现在，所凭仗的可不单单是他的战力。
他是战力是很强，单打独斗他能稳胜文都上人和梦秋圣姑二人中的任何一人。
可若是以一敌二，那他自然是处于下风。
能支撑到现在，神级上品的天材地宝和神丹可是起到了极为重要的作用。
一时间，八雷尊者目光落在这些漂浮在半空中琳琅满目的天材地宝上，呼吸都变得有些急促。
此刻的他就宛如一名极其饥渴的凡人遇到了清澈甘甜的水源与香喷喷的食物似得，实在是太心动了。
见八雷尊者这幅如饥似渴的摸样，剑尘微微一笑，道：“对，我拿出的这些上品神丹以及上品神材，你需要什么尽管拿取，毕竟你现在这幅状态急需这些资源恢复自身，不然哪天文都上人和梦秋圣姑再次打上门来，那你们靖天盟拿什么抵抗？”
八雷尊者知道剑尘说的是实情，以他现在这幅状态，一旦再次遭遇文都上人和梦秋圣姑，那纵使有八极雷阵辅助也难有胜算。
他目光不禁在这琳琅满目的天材地宝上来回扫视，在经过短暂的迟疑后，终究是没能忍住内心的诱惑与渴望，咬牙道：“既然如此，那老夫就不客气了。”
话落，八雷尊者袖袍一挥，瞬间就将剑尘拿出的这些上品神丹以及上品神材收走了一半。
“这些，足矣！”他嘴上这样说道，目光却下意识在余下的上品神丹以及上品神材上扫过，眼底深处仍带着几许掩饰不住的垂涎。
他取走的天材地宝已经不少，但似乎，还想要？
毕竟都是神级上品的神材和神丹，如此珍贵的保命资源，除了剑尘外，还有谁会嫌多？
剑尘看出了八雷尊者的想法，不过他可不会惯着八雷尊者，淡笑间将余下的天材地宝和神级丹药尽数收了起来，对着八雷尊者说道：“前辈抓紧时间疗伤吧，我们在这里逗留的时间不能太长，前辈失踪一事若是在端靖天界传扬了出去，那靖天盟还不知会乱成什么样子。”
八雷尊者点了点头，也不废话，当即就从一个玉瓶内倒出两粒上品神丹吞服下去，然后就地盘坐开始恢复自身，一副完全不设防的姿态。
没有人比他更明白他自身的状态，他现在的伤势可谓是糟糕透顶，不仅境界跌落，并且本源更是受损严重。

以他这幅状态，别说同时抵挡文都上人和梦秋圣姑二人联手了，哪怕是单独对上他们当中的任何一人都毫无胜算。
太初神殿第一层空间的余波彻底平息。
八雷尊者如老僧入定似得，端坐在那里归然不动，在全速恢复。
在他不远处，剑尘同样盘膝而坐，也在恢复自身。
当然，他恢复的方向与八雷尊者不同。
八雷尊者是在疗伤，而剑尘身上并没有伤势，他只是动用玄剑气对元神之力消耗太大，此刻正在恢复自身的元神力量，同时凝练新的玄剑气。
content_en:
"Senior Ba Lei, just take whatever you need, no need to be polite!" Jian Chen said nonchalantly, looking very heroic and not taking these immeasurable high-grade divine materials seriously at all.
"These god-level top-grade heavenly materials and earthly treasures, as well as god-level top-grade elixirs, can I really take whatever I want?" Lord Ba Lei asked tentatively, with obvious doubts and disbelief.
Because he is very aware of the value of these heavenly materials and earthly treasures, especially after experiencing the war in Duanjing Heaven Realm, he has an extremely deep understanding of the meaning of each high-grade divine elixir and high-grade divine elixir.
These resources are life-saving things and are of great significance.
In the battle with Master Wendu and Saint Mengqiu, the reason why Venerable Eight Thunders has been able to endure until now is not only based on his combat power.
His combat power is very strong, and he can definitely defeat either Master Wendu or Saint Mengqiu in a single fight.
But if it was one versus two, then he would naturally be at a disadvantage.
To be able to sustain it until now, the god-level high-grade heavenly materials, earthly treasures and divine elixirs have played an extremely important role.
For a moment, Lord Ba Lei's eyes fell on these dazzling array of heavenly materials and earthly treasures floating in the air, and his breathing became a little short.
At this moment, he was like an extremely hungry mortal who encountered clear and sweet water and fragrant food. He was really excited.
Seeing the hungry look of Lord Ba Lei, Jian Chen smiled slightly and said: "Yes, you can take whatever you need from these high-grade divine elixirs and high-grade divine materials that I took out. After all, you are in urgent need of these resources to restore yourself in this current state. Otherwise, Master Tian Wendu and Saint Aunt Mengqiu will come knocking on the door again one day. Then how can you Jingtian Alliance resist?"
Lord Eight Thunders knew that Jian Chen was telling the truth. In his current state, once he encountered Master Wendu and Saint Mengqiu again, even with the assistance of the Eight Extremes Thunder Formation, he would have no chance of winning.
He couldn't help but glance back and forth at this dazzling array of heavenly materials and earthly treasures. After a brief hesitation, he finally couldn't resist the temptation and desire in his heart. He gritted his teeth and said, "In that case, I won't be polite."
After finishing his words, Lord Ba Lei waved his sleeves and instantly took away half of the high-grade divine elixirs and high-grade divine materials that Jian Chen took out.
"These are enough!" He said this, but his eyes subconsciously swept over the remaining high-grade divine elixirs and high-grade divine materials, and there was still a little bit of covetousness deep in his eyes that could not be concealed.
He has already taken away a lot of treasures, but it seems that he still wants them?
After all, they are all god-level top-grade divine materials and divine elixirs. With such precious life-saving resources, who else but Jian Chen would have too much?
Jian Chen saw the thoughts of the Eight Thunder Masters, but he would not be spoiled by the Eight Thunder Lords. He put away all the remaining heavenly materials, earth treasures and god-level elixirs with a faint smile, and said to the Eight Thunder Lords: "Senior, hurry up and heal your wounds. We cannot stay here for too long. If the news of the senior's disappearance spreads in the Duanjing Heaven Realm, the Jingtian Alliance will not know what kind of chaos it will be."
Lord Ba Lei nodded without any nonsense. He immediately poured out two high-grade divine pills from a jade bottle and swallowed them. Then he sat cross-legged on the spot and began to recover himself, showing a completely undefended posture.
No one understands his own condition better than him. His current injury is extremely bad. Not only has his realm dropped, but his origin has been seriously damaged.
In his current state, let alone fending off Master Wendu and Saint Mengqiu at the same time, he had no chance of winning against either of them alone.
The aftermath of the first space in the Taichu Temple completely subsided.
Lord Ba Lei seemed to be in samadhi like an old monk, sitting there motionless and recovering at full speed.
Not far away from him, Jian Chen was also sitting cross-legged and recovering himself.
Of course, the direction of his recovery was different from that of Lord Eight Thunders.
Lord Ba Lei was healing his wounds, but Jian Chen was notThere was no injury, he just used the Xuanjian Qi to consume too much of his Yuanshen power. At this moment, he was recovering his Yuanshen power and condensing new Xuanjian Qi.
